from.help: Where the unit stands: on the square, next to it, or either.

by.help: How it can be opened: a key, a unit's trait (a thief's skill), or by breaking it (doors with hp).

keys.help: Only these key items open it (they need an opens list; needs by to hold key).

id.help: Unique id; map legends, factions and upgrades name it.

rings.help: Hexagon games instead of width / height: 0 = one hexagon, 1 = it and its six neighbours.

moveCost.help: Cost per move type, replacing the terrain's (0 = cannot enter).

props.help: Numbers that replace or add to the terrain's (defense ...).

tags.help: Free words; hq marks the headquarters (defeat: lostHq).

capturePoints.help: More than 0 = it can be captured.

income.help: Resources per turn to the owner (needs rules.economy).

produces.help: Unit types the owner can build here (needs rules.production).

sells.help: Items it sells (each needs a price).

research.help: Counts as a research structure (needs rules.research needsStructure).

repairs.help: Unit types or tags it repairs (missing = all, [] = none; rules.supply.repair).

blocksSight.help: Fog of war: units do not see past it.

light.help: Fog of war: it lights this many squares around it.

upgrades.help: Kinds it can be built up into (same size).

requires.help: A technology that must be researched first.

door.help: A door: blocks some move types until opened, then becomes another kind (docs/SRPG.md section 10).

opens.help: The kind it becomes when opened.

hp.help: Hit points: makes the door something that can be attacked.

stats.help: Numbers its damage formula reads (needs hp).

word.help: What the menu calls it when attacked (letters, at most 16), e.g. wall.

chest.help: A chest: opened for what is inside (the map says what).

opens.help: The kind it becomes when opened.

visit.help: A place a unit can visit (a village).

becomes.help: The kind it becomes after a visit.

ruin.help: The kind it becomes when destroyed.

weapon.help: A map weapon (ballista): the weapon item a unit standing here attacks with.

uses.help: Shots of the map weapon (leave out for unlimited).

ignoreRank.help: Any unit may use the map weapon whatever its weapon rank.

by.help: Who may use the map weapon.

becomes.help: The kind the map weapon turns into when used up.
